notes.geometry: User specifications override all early model dimensions. 2.92 m is the selected straight-wheel tire envelope, not a body measurement.
notes.radii: Nominal tire marking / 2 used as provisional simulation radii, not measured loaded or effective rolling radii.
notes.widths: Unverified Hankook catalog section widths used for initial visual and wheel geometry, not from the early model.
notes.steering: User-selected temporary +/-20 degrees. 추후 확인 꼭 필요.
notes.motor: Renault donor reference peak 57 Nm, 13 kW, 0-2100 rpm torque plateau; inferred envelope thereafter. Installed SEVCON calibration not verified.
notes.cutoff: 7500 rpm is an explicit simulation placeholder, not an OEM verified limit or a road speed limiter.
notes.ratio: 9.23:1 is a donor-document candidate, not a verified installed gearbox ratio.
notes.differential: Open rear differential is a provisional modeling choice; actual locking behavior unknown.
notes.unmeasured: COM at collision box center and 50:50 static axle load are provisional. Tire forces, wheel mass, suspension, brakes, drag and inertia require measurements. Battery, inverter current/thermal/SOC effects and regen are not modeled in v1.
notes.origin: Modeling convention: midpoint of axles, straight-wheel nominal ground plane; +X forward +Y left +Z up in Blender. Unreal uses +Y right. This is not a measured vehicle or sensor frame.
